result.disposition: All seven frozen evidence-found fields were source-reuse resolved after a current-page recheck. WINSPACE's exact M6 builds support the shared frame/fork carbon construction; the Japan page publishes 700×32C. The original T1600 105 Di2 page supports Toray T1000+T1100/Kevlar construction and qualitative stiffness/power-transfer wording; its Japan page publishes 700×32C. XDS AD7 regional Green Demon pages support the listed 105 Di2 hydraulic 2×12 drivetrain and Taiwan AD7 detail supports the T700/T800 carbon frame and carbon fork. All retained mainland trim/build ambiguities remain explicit; tire 32C is nominal tire size, not measured physical clearance.

field_results.caveat: Exact build pages support T700+T800+M40+M60 frame and full-carbon fork for their named builds; retained mainland coupon trim and fiber proportions remain unresolved.
Current manufacturer regional page publishes 700×32C; this is nominal tire size, not 32 mm measured internal clearance or proof of the retained mainland build.
Exact original T1600 105 Di2 page supports Toray T1000+T1100 carbon, Kevlar and full-carbon fork; T1600 Ultra is excluded, while retained trim and lay-up proportions remain unknown.
Manufacturer supports only qualitative engineered-for-stiffness and power-transfer language; no numeric magnitude, structural protocol or independent exact-frame measurement.
Current original-T1600 manufacturer regional page publishes 700×32C; nominal tire-size limit, not measured 32 mm physical clearance; T1600 Ultra is distinct.
The exact Hong Kong Green Demon listing supports 105 Di2 hydraulic 2×12, 11–34T and 50/34T; it does not establish the retained mainland coupon checkout's complete BOM.
Current Taiwan AD7 product detail supports T700/T800 carbon aero frame and carbon fork among multiple listed configurations; it does not identify the retained mainland SKU.
